title: SB1348 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-02-06; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513074359 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB1348.pdf (LegiScan doc 3107195))
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2025-02-06; summary says "As introduced", no passage vote listed, so no adopted amendments are missing. Twin bill on one document (HB1392/SB1348). Bill only deletes text; quoted instruction sentences are the change. Per summary the deleted subsection (g) covers lawful handgun possessors in a lawful place aged 21, or 18 with military service.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (g).
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): deleting "or who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(g)".
